entry.name: count~
entry.description: Use the count~ object count samples elapsed and thus drive processes tightly synchronized to the sample rate. It outputs a signal increasing by 1 for each sample elapsed. It can be set to loop, and can be used to drive objects such as index~ with sample accuracy.

arguments.name: count-limit
arguments.description: Set a count limit for a looping counter, or 0 for no count limit. Note that the limit value is never reached.

arguments.name: enable
arguments.description: Specify whether theobject is off (0) or on (1) initially.

arguments.name: autoreset-state
arguments.description: When enabled, the internal counter is reset to the initial value whenever audio is turned on (see themessage).
